moments.title: The annunciation
moments.line: The angel Gabriel tells Mary in Nazareth that she will bear a son named Jesus.

moments.title: Born in Bethlehem
moments.line: Jesus is born in Bethlehem and laid in a feeding trough.

moments.title: Shepherds hear the news
moments.line: An angel announces the birth to shepherds nearby, who go and find the child.

moments.title: Presented in the temple
moments.line: Mary and Joseph present the infant Jesus in the temple, where Simeon blesses him.

moments.title: Visit of the magi
moments.line: Wise men from the east follow a star to Bethlehem and offer the child gifts.

moments.title: Flight to Egypt
moments.line: Warned in a dream, Joseph takes the family to Egypt until Herod dies, then settles in Nazareth.

moments.title: The boy in the temple
moments.line: At twelve, Jesus stays behind in Jerusalem and is found in the temple among the teachers.

moments.title: Baptized in the Jordan
moments.line: John baptizes Jesus in the Jordan River, and a voice from heaven calls him the beloved Son.

moments.title: Tempted in the wilderness
moments.line: Jesus fasts forty days in the wilderness and answers each temptation with Scripture.

moments.title: Water into wine at Cana
moments.line: At a wedding in Cana, Jesus turns water into wine, his first recorded sign.

moments.title: The Samaritan woman
moments.line: On the way north, Jesus speaks with a Samaritan woman at Jacob's well and tells her he is the Messiah.

moments.title: Rejected at Nazareth
moments.line: Jesus reads Isaiah in the Nazareth synagogue, and the town drives him out.

moments.title: Ministry base at Capernaum
moments.line: Jesus settles in Capernaum, teaching in the synagogue and healing many.

moments.title: Calling the fishermen
moments.line: After a great catch of fish, Peter, Andrew, James, and John leave their nets to follow Jesus.

moments.title: Sermon on the Mount
moments.line: On a mountainside Jesus teaches the crowds, beginning with the Beatitudes.

moments.title: Calming the storm
moments.line: Jesus stills a storm on the Sea of Galilee with a word.

moments.title: The Gerasene demoniac
moments.line: In the country of the Gerasenes, Jesus frees a man possessed by a legion of demons.

moments.title: Feeding the five thousand
moments.line: Near Bethsaida, Jesus feeds about five thousand men with five loaves and two fish.

moments.title: Walking on the water
moments.line: Jesus walks across the Sea of Galilee to the disciples' boat in the night.

moments.title: The Syrophoenician woman
moments.line: In the region of Tyre and Sidon, Jesus heals the daughter of a Gentile woman who asks in faith.

moments.title: Peter's confession
moments.line: At Caesarea Philippi, Peter declares that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of the living God.

moments.title: The transfiguration
moments.line: On a high mountain, Jesus is transfigured before Peter, James, and John, with Moses and Elijah appearing.

moments.title: Setting out for Jerusalem
moments.line: Jesus resolutely sets his face to go to Jerusalem, traveling and teaching along the way.

moments.title: Raising of Lazarus
moments.line: At Bethany, Jesus calls Lazarus out of the tomb four days after his death.

moments.title: Healing blind Bartimaeus
moments.line: Near Jericho, Jesus restores the sight of a blind beggar who calls him Son of David.

moments.title: Zacchaeus the tax collector
moments.line: In Jericho, Jesus stays at the house of Zacchaeus, who repays those he wronged.

moments.title: Anointed at Bethany
moments.line: At Bethany, Mary anoints Jesus with costly ointment ahead of his burial.

moments.title: Triumphal entry
moments.line: Jesus rides into Jerusalem on a donkey as crowds spread branches and shout Hosanna.

moments.title: Cleansing the temple
moments.line: Jesus drives the money changers and merchants out of the temple courts.

moments.title: The Last Supper
moments.line: At a Passover meal, Jesus gives the disciples bread and the cup as his body and blood.

harmony.title: The Institution of the Lord's Supper

moments.title: Gethsemane
moments.line: Jesus prays in the garden of Gethsemane and is arrested there after Judas betrays him.

moments.title: Trials before the rulers
moments.line: Jesus is tried by the council, then sent to Pilate and Herod.

moments.title: The crucifixion
moments.line: Jesus is crucified at the place called The Skull, between two criminals, and dies.

moments.title: Buried in the tomb
moments.line: Joseph of Arimathea lays the body of Jesus in a new tomb cut from rock.

moments.title: Risen from the dead
moments.line: On the first day of the week, the tomb is found empty and Jesus is announced risen.

moments.title: The road to Emmaus
moments.line: The risen Jesus walks with two disciples to Emmaus and is recognized in the breaking of bread.

moments.title: Appearing to Thomas
moments.line: Jesus appears to the disciples in Jerusalem, and a week later shows Thomas his hands and side.

moments.title: Breakfast by the sea
moments.line: The risen Jesus meets seven disciples fishing on the Sea of Galilee and eats with them.

moments.title: The great commission
moments.line: On a mountain in Galilee, Jesus sends the disciples to make disciples of all nations.

moments.title: The ascension
moments.line: Near Bethany, Jesus blesses the disciples and is taken up into heaven.
